items.title: CJP submits formal letter to Delhi Police seeking a Jantar Mantar protest date; 24-hour ultimatum now in writing
items.summary: CJP submitted a formal representation to the DCP, Parliament Street Police Station, asking police to pick a date of their choosing for a peaceful Jantar Mantar demonstration (flipping the 10-day notice rule back on the police) and to de-escalate law-enforcement presence. The letter alleges 'severe disruption and widespread public distress' with over 55,000 police and paramilitary personnel deployed, citing arbitrary detentions, physical aggression and prolonged custody, plus financial strain on businesses from road closures. It warns that if police do not respond within 24 hours of receipt, CJP will continue protesting peacefully and announce a mass-protest date. Ashutosh Ranka added that the DCP, Additional DCP and SHO were all absent when the delegation arrived. Note: Saurav Das and Ranka handed the letter in during the already-alerted 10 AM IST PS visit; this is the first publication of the letter's full text and claims.
